purpose: Pre-stage seven self-contained Urdu A2 production sessions so work can resume immediately without reconstructing scope, arithmetic, roadmap, or validation rules.

unit01_required_artifacts: reading/audit/urdu_a2_u01_quality_pass_2026-08-23.json after the bounded quality remediation completes
pre_week_gate.rule: If main already satisfies the required state and continuation validation passes, do not redo Unit 1. Otherwise integrate the vetted Unit 1 branch through a normal merge/PR path that preserves concurrent unrelated main work.

lexical_policy: Treat frequency/planning band as a curriculum aid, never as a CEFR fact.
Default to a small verified load: normally about 2 deliberate new targets in P1-P4 when natural; use fewer when grammar/discourse load is higher.
P5 should be cumulative with zero or minimal new deliberate vocabulary; P6 should introduce no deliberate new lexical target unless an explicitly documented exception is pedagogically necessary.
Resolve candidate targets from reading/lexicons/urdu.jsonl minus all new_lexical_target IDs already present in live canonical Urdu A1/A2.
Do not rely on reading/ledgers/urdu_lexical_exposure.jsonl as scheduling truth until its stale introduced_in state is rebuilt from canonical passages.
Verify the exact learner-facing sense before a target is committed; dictionary existence alone is not sufficient when the sense/collocation is ambiguous.
question_policy: Exactly 10 questions and 10 linked answers per passage under reading/planning/TEN_QUESTION_STANDARD.md.
At A2, prefer operational grammar/form-use over formal metalanguage.
Every deliberate new lexical target must receive meaning-in-context or transfer assessment, plus later retrieval/recycling.
Cloze items must be uniquely defensible in a new sentence/context rather than copied blanks from the passage.
language_policy: Write independent contemporary standard Urdu in Unicode Urdu script.
Do not translate Arabic or French passages sentence-by-sentence.
Reject Hindi-only, archaic, noisy-dictionary, or mismatched senses unless explicitly intended and labeled.
Prefer natural collocations even when that means using fewer target occurrences.
transaction_order: Confirm current branch/main head and run python reading/tools/validate_continuation_state.py.
Confirm ACTIVE_GENERATION_PLAN points to the expected unit and start sequence for this packet.
Select and independently sense-check deliberate targets before canonical write.
Generate all six records with immutable IDs, correct sequence numbers, 10 q/a each, and 140-220-word standard-band prose unless a documented exception is warranted.
Run a reader-first bounded quality pass for naturalness, target-sense clarity, answer grounding, operational grammar, and fluency new-word policy.
Update reading/STATUS.json, reading/CONTINUATION.json, reading/TASKS.md, and derived plan as required by the state contract.
Run python reading/tools/extract_active_generation_plan.py, then python reading/tools/refresh_state_manifest.py, then python reading/tools/validate_continuation_state.py.
Integrate through a merge/PR path that preserves concurrent unrelated main commits; never force main to an older branch tree.
shared_session_contract.release_guard: Generation/integrity PASS never promotes educator/publication readiness. RELEASE_STATUS.json changes only when release evidence itself changes.

sessions.focus: Plan/replan language, invitation responses, schedule changes, reasons, and short reference chains.
Connected past narration, temporal ordering, remembered detail, and simple contrast between then/now.
Comparisons, prices/features, purchase problems, evidence-based complaints, and practical resolution.
Learning processes, practice habits, simple instructions, progress, and choosing strategies.
Schedules, route choices, delays, tickets/information, changed plans, and multi-step travel decisions.
Who/what/when/where reporting, announcements, simple cause/effect, and reactions grounded in the text.
Concrete environmental observations, simple explanations, local actions, and cause/consequence without unsupported factual claims.
